what_happened.line: The captured portion of the Select Board meeting records no votes, decisions or budget items.
Board members warned of email scams and said outgoing town email was broken.
A resident opposed one of four candidates for three building committee seats, citing past use of contingency funds on the school building committee.
Another resident announced the Lunenburg ROAR forum on youth and pain management for October 17 at the middle high school auditorium.
A high school community service club began a kindness rocks presentation, where the captions end.

why_it_matters: Nothing in this portion changes a tax bill or a service, but the building committee seats are an election residents will be asked to vote on, and the comment shows how past project spending is being weighed.
The board's note that outgoing email was down may affect residents waiting on replies from town offices.
